entities.name: Subgraph Retrieval
entities.description: A method involving retrieving top-k paths from topic entities and merging subgraphs.

entities.name: Wen et al.
entities.description: Researchers who propose merging retrieved subgraphs based on relations.

entities.name: Li et al.
entities.description: Researchers mentioned in multiple contexts: merging subgraphs, reranking triplets, and training PLMs.

entities.name: Knowledge Pruning
entities.description: A technique involving filtering out less relevant or redundant retrieved information.

entities.name: crossencoder
entities.description: A pre-trained model used by Li et al. to re-rank retrieved triplets.

entities.name: FlagEmbedding
entities.description: A tool used by Jiang et al. to encode text for reranking.

entities.name: bge_reranker_large
entities.description: An embedding model used by Jiang et al. to return top-k documents.

entities.name: Jiang et al.
entities.description: Researchers who utilize FlagEmbedding and bge_reranker_large for reranking.

entities.name: Liu et al.
entities.description: Researchers who train a PLM for reranking.

entities.name: Cheng et al.
entities.description: Researchers who re-rank candidate subgraphs based on similarity.

entities.name: Taunk et al.
entities.description: Researchers who cluster 2-hop neighbors and delete clusters with low similarity.

entities.name: Yasunaga et al.
entities.description: Researchers who prune retrieved subgraphs based on relevance scores calculated by a pre-trained language model.

relationships.description: Wen et al. propose merging retrieved subgraphs based on relations within the context of Subgraph Retrieval.
Li et al. propose merging retrieved subgraphs based on relations within the context of Subgraph Retrieval.
Li et al. adopt a pre-trained crossencoder to re-rank retrieved triplets.
Jiang et al. utilize FlagEmbedding to encode text for reranking.
Jiang et al. utilize the embedding model bge_reranker_large.
Cheng et al. implement a knowledge pruning strategy by re-ranking candidate subgraphs based on similarity.
Taunk et al. implement a knowledge pruning strategy by clustering and deleting low-similarity clusters.
Yasunaga et al. implement a knowledge pruning strategy by pruning subgraphs according to relevance scores.
